info.name: Jewellery E-Commerce API
info.description:
Complete API test suite for the Jewellery E-Commerce admin panel.

## Execution Order

Run folders in this order:
1. **Auth** — Login to get session cookie
2. **Categories** — CRUD (creates parent + child)
3. **Products** — CRUD (uses category from step 2)
4. **Users** — CRUD
5. **Roles** — CRUD
6. **Cleanup & Logout** — End admin session
7. **Customer Auth** — Register, login, profile, password reset, email verify

## Global Variables

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `base_url` | API base URL (default: `http://localhost:3000`) |
| `admin_email` | Admin login email |
| `admin_password` | Admin login password |
| `category_id` | Auto-set after category creation |
| `child_category_id` | Auto-set after child category creation |
| `product_id` | Auto-set after product creation |
| `user_id` | Auto-set after user creation |
| `role_id` | Auto-set after role creation |
| `customer_id` | Auto-set after customer registration |
| `customer_email` | Auto-set after customer registration |
